title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Pixelbarn builds design tools for small studios. You will lead the frontend of our editor.

Requirements
- 6+ years of frontend work with React and TypeScript.
- Deep knowledge of the browser rendering path, CSS and accessibility.
- You have shipped a design system.
- Experience with WebGL or canvas is a strong plus.

You will mentor 3 engineers. Hybrid in Lisbon.
